name: Allen Beasley
bio: Redpoint Ventures : Team Member Allen Beasley Allen Beasley is a partner with Redpoint Ventures. Prior to joining Redpoint, Allen was an associate with IVP, a firm he joined in 1998. Allen focuses on data center infrastructure investments, and he currently serves on the Boards of Directors of Candera , Allocity , OuterBay and MetaTV . Allen also led or was actively involved in investments in ON Semiconductor (ONNN) and TopSpin Communications . name: Greg Martin

Jim focuses on the networking and communications space, and he has worked closely with a variety of portfolio companies, including TransMedia (acquired by Cisco), Freegate , Lightera (acquired by Ciena), Mayan Networks and Vivace . Prior to joining Brentwood, Jim was President and CEO of OnStream Networks, which was sold to 3Com for $254 million in 1996. Before that, Jim was President and CEO of Larscom. He has held senior management position in a number of networking companies including GDC as Sales Manager, Timeplex as Director of National Accounts, Doeltz Networks and Larscom as Vice President of Sales and Marketing before becoming CEO in 1994. name: John McQuillan
bio: Redpoint Ventures -- Delivering the Network Effect Redpoint Team EIR Program John McQuillan Dr. John McQuillan is a venture partner with Redpoint Ventures. Prior to joining Redpoint, John was a venture partner with IVP, a firm he began working with in 1988. John is a network pioneer, a leading authority on advanced networks, and a venture capitalist. At McQuillan Ventures , he evaluates new business opportunities in advanced networking, and serves as an investor and advisor to entrepreneurs. John has worked closely with a variety of portfolio companies, including Growth Networks , MMC Networks (MMCN), Onebox.com , Redstone (acquired by Siemens), Shasta Networks (acquired by Nortel) and Turnstone . John spent the first decade of his career at BBN with pioneering work on the ARPANET, which was the predecessor of the Internet. He invented link state routing, and developed the SPF (Shortest Path First) routing algorithm. This research is the foundation for most present-day algorithms for routers and ATM switches such as OSPF and PNNI. He also developed the first network management system for a packet network. John has advised many leading network vendors, carriers, customers, investors, and start-ups.
